term: potency, capacity and power across adopted and rival configurations
resolution: In every ADOPTED-POTENCY specialization, potency is precisely DEF-POTENCY: CanBe x r ∧ ¬ InAct x r, with one shared act predicate and respect throughout. All motion, priority, pure-act/immutability, eternity and attribute-sufficiency occurrences are uniformly substituted in the new frozen signatures; no proof transfers from this function to a separately supplied potency predicate. Generic original Challenges retain DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY, including the act/potency-independence and Night models. Their simultaneous-act cases are a different interpretation, not refuted by adopting the definition. Night priority claims without simultaneous act can remain genuine rivals to act priority even under an adopted interpretation; no blanket defeat is claimed. A power/capacity retained during exercise is DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE (or a causal capacity in DEF-POWER-CAPACITY-READING), not adopted unactualized capacity; its persistence while acting is consistent with the adopted definition. DEF-MEGARIAN-ACTUALIST-CAPACITY restricts the capacity relation itself. The existing one-way thesis is retained in full; it is not refuted by definition and its motion refutation keeps its additional premises. DEF-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY relates principles to a received act and can coexist with actual possession, so the adopted same-respect non-overlap theorem is never applied to it. DISAMB-IN-ACT independently distinguishes formal from virtual act; the adopted function uses exactly the supplied sense everywhere and does not attribute a virtual-act analysis to IX.6. Sense fork (batch 3, #1233 B; docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md): the prima via step to STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-SAME-RESPECT uses 'in potency' twice (what is moved is in potency; nothing is in act and in potency). Its readings are three senses, each its own declaration: POTENCY_1 = DEF-POTENCY (AdoptedPotency.InPotency), POTENCY_2 = DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY (the primitive InPotency parameter), POTENCY_3 = DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE (CapacityPotency). Coverage STMT-POTENCY-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE and exclusivity STMT-POTENCY-SENSE-UNIQUE are OPEN premises. Per sense: NO-SELF-MOTION-FROM-ADOPTED-POTENCY (no non-simultaneity premise needed), the existing AQUINAS-NO-SELF-MOTION-SAME-RESPECT (INDEPENDENT), and NO-SELF-MOTION-FROM-CAPACITY, whose non-simultaneity premise is refuted under STMT-SOME-CAPACITY-EXERCISED (supplied both by Aristotle's builder and by the Megarian thesis with some capacity). STMT-MOVED-ONLY-AS-IN-ADOPTED-POTENCY strengthens STMT-MOVED-ONLY-AS-CAPABLE. Summary POTENCY-SENSE-FORK-NO-SELF-MOTION; the controls show the mixed reading (moved use CAPACITY, non-simultaneity ADOPTED) allows self-motion. Not senses of this use: DEF-MEGARIAN-ACTUALIST-CAPACITY is a thesis constraining POTENCY_3's relation, used as a premise against that branch; DEF-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY relates a principle to a received act, a different Lean type, so it cannot be substituted for the route's use (DISAMB-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY).
